say:2:1041567301:0.text: Fourteen explosions today, and every single one was flawless!
say:2:1041567301:0.source_cn: 今天又完成了十四次完美无缺的爆炸！

say:3:1041567302:0.text: Wonderful. I received a lot of positive feedback from miners.
say:3:1041567302:0.source_cn: 很棒很棒，我已经接到那边对你的称赞了。

say:4:1041567303:0.text: How did you choose the locations this time?
say:4:1041567303:0.source_cn: 这次你炸点的选择是怎么想的？

say:5:1041567304:0.text: I don't know. It's just a feeling. Places I feel that were better than others.
say:5:1041567304:0.source_cn: 呃，就还是那样啊，就，光凭着感觉，感觉那里比较好。

say:6:1041567305:0.text: No. Before you used to pick locations that allowed you to make big explosions.
say:6:1041567305:0.source_cn: 不不不，你以前选择炸点，是会选择威力比较大的位置。

say:7:1041567306:0.text: For example, with a few areas you linked together, you quickly carved out the biggest amount of space.
say:7:1041567306:0.source_cn: 比如用几个点，就可以迅速开凿出最大的空间。

say:8:1041567307:0.text: But this time, I was told that you chose a location closest to the vein.
say:8:1041567307:0.source_cn: 但这次选择，我接到的汇报是，你选择了最接近矿脉的位置。

say:9:1041567308:0.text: Well, it's because the old guy leading the group said the place was safe around, but the vein was deep.
say:9:1041567308:0.source_cn: 因为那个带头的大叔说周围很安全，但矿脉很深。

say:10:1041567309:0.text: I was blasting in the spot he pointed out, but halfway through I adjusted for some reason...
say:10:1041567309:0.source_cn: 我是按照他提供的位置进行爆破的，但中途也不知道为什么就...

say:11:1041567310:0.text: Ah, it's still a matter of knowing what you know and knowing what you don't...
say:11:1041567310:0.source_cn: 唔，还是知其然不知其所以然啊。

say:12:1041567311:0.text: Kulu, have you thought about going to school? Reading and learning some theoretical concepts...
say:12:1041567311:0.source_cn: 库露露，你有没有考虑过念念书？去学习些理论知识——

say:13:1041567312:0.text: Because I heard that many Hypogeans are well versed in books, poetry, and academia.
say:13:1041567312:0.source_cn: 我可是听说了，许多恶魔也是深谙诗书的哦？

say:14:1041567313:0.text: Really? Do you mean that super powerful Hypogeans read, study, and do stuff like that...?
say:14:1041567313:0.source_cn: 真的吗？厉害的恶魔也要学习吗……

say:15:1041567314:0.text: Wait! That doesn't sound right! I'm not going to fall for that! You can't make me read!
say:15:1041567314:0.source_cn: 不对！我才不会上当！我才不会学那些乱七八糟的东西！
